deal.amna.argile: A wheel for some clay (she insists)
end.community.desc: “History is written by those who can draw on walls.”
end.ingenuity.desc: “Fire: heats, cooks, lights. Do not touch.”
end.trade.desc: “The first social network: three pebbles and a rumor.”
npc.amna.desc: “It's called a wheel. No, you can't eat it.”
npc.ancienne.desc: “In my day, we drew mammoths by hand.”
npc.bob.desc: “One, two, three… ten. What comes after ten? Lots?”
npc.nick.desc: “Premium pebble, limited edition. Looks like the others: that's the genius of it.”
patent.bouche-a-oreille.desc: Contracts offer one more client and announce the next market trend.
patent.brouillon-genie.desc: The first advanced recipe of each era is unlocked from the start.
patent.greniers-pleins.desc: +2 h of offline cap, and base stations at level 5 from the start of each era.
patent.memoire-clan.desc: Every event offers a third choice.
quest.amna-four.0: Amna wants to prove technique changes everything. Make 200 pots or 200 tools.
quest.amna-four.1: She asks for a workshop worthy of her. Level up the Clay pit or the Workshop.
quest.amna-roue.0: Amna invented the wheel. Find a use for it before she turns it into a table.
quest.amna-roue.1: She wants a cart. She needs tools, or at least trinkets to persuade people.
quest.amna-roue.2: The cart rolls. Nobody knows where to. “It rolls, so what?”
quest.ancienne-mur.0: The Elder wants the cave repainted: ochre, or some ready-made paintings.
quest.ancienne-mur.1: She reviews your work. At length. Level up the campfire to last until the end.
quest.ancienne-recit.0: The Elder wants to tell the clan's story. Earn 20,000 shells to fund it.
quest.ancienne-recit.1: It still needs an ending. The Elder waits for your Era Key to come close: level up the Barter circle.
quest.atelier.0: Build the Knapping workshop. It's where a rock becomes a career.
quest.bob-compte.0: Bob wants to count to 100 berries. He only has 10 fingers. Help him anyway.
quest.bob-tableau.0: Bob wants a “dashboard” to track berries. Grow the foraging first.
quest.bob-tableau.1: He carves one line per berry on a stone. So he needs many berries.
quest.bob-tableau.2: The stone weighs 40 kg. Bob presents it to the clan. No questions from the floor.
quest.camp: The mammoth won't come by itself
quest.camp.0: The clan wants meat. And hides. And fewer speeches.
quest.carriere.0: With one flint you can break more flint. Bob calls it a supply chain.
quest.cercle.0: Bob wants a Barter circle. He has already scheduled the kickoff meeting.
quest.champ-q.0: Settle the clan down. They protest sitting down.
quest.champ-q.1: Plant the Primitive field, then wait. Then wait some more.
quest.clan-voisin.0: The clan next door wants 30 tanned hides by nightfall. Night falls late this year.
quest.economie.0: Earn 5,000 shells on the market. Bob is already talking inflation without knowing what it is.
quest.feu.0: Buy “Skilled hand”: playing with fire takes nimble fingers.
quest.feu.1: Light the Campfire. The Elder has stories to tell. Long ones.
quest.fosse.0: Learn the language of barter in the tree.
quest.fosse.1: Dig the Clay pit. It's filthy, but it's art.
quest.grain-q.0: Produce 300 units of grain. Bob promises not to count them.
quest.le-cercle-q.0: Buy “The Circle”: the tree opens and the clan must choose what to become.
quest.le-cercle-q.1: Bob learns numbers exist after ten. He needs a moment, and 10,000 berries.
quest.livraison-mixte.0: The river clan wants 80 trinkets or 80 tools. They can't tell the difference.
quest.nick-caillou.0: Nick sells premium pebbles. Buy a bundle, for scientific curiosity.
quest.nick-caillou.1: He's already reselling them next door. Earn 1,000 shells to keep up.
quest.opt-community-1.0: The Elder wants 200 paintings. She has opinions on each one.
quest.opt-community-2.0: Store 1,000 trinkets for the party. Nobody knows what it's for.
quest.opt-ingenuity-1.0: Amna wants 300 pots for a prototype. It will not work.
quest.opt-ingenuity-2.0: Make 1,000 units of ochre. Amna wants to patent red.
quest.opt-throughput-1.0: Store 2,000 units of grain. Bob counts granaries instead.
quest.opt-throughput-2.0: Get the Field to level 30. Back pain included.
quest.opt-trade-1.0: Nick wants to test a route: 200 tanned hides, no questions asked.
quest.opt-trade-2.0: Make 1,000 trinkets. Nick calls it a trend.
quest.premier-troc.0: Bob offers 1 flint for 5 berries. He counted twice. He isn't sure.
quest.premiere-vente.0: Nick says anything sells. Prove him right: earn 50 shells on the market.
quest.sel-contrat.0: Curing season is coming. Nick wants 120 units of salt.
quest.source.0: Tame the fire in the tree.
quest.source.1: Tap the Salt spring. The meat will thank you, your blood pressure less so.
quest.tannerie-q.0: Weave the first baskets in the tree.
quest.tannerie-q.1: Build the Tannery. Far from camp, preferably.
quest.voisins-baies.0: The clan next door wants 150 berries. They pay in shells, or in promises.
res.coquillages.desc: “Never loses value. Except at high tide.”
res.fresques.desc: “The first news feed. Updated every 2,000 years.”
res.ocre.desc: “Lipstick, paintbrush and wall paint in one.”
res.sel.desc: “Precious enough to get paid in. Remember that one.”
res.silex.desc: “The pocket knife of 8000 BC. Without the options.”
st.atelier-taille.desc: “High tech: sharp on one side, not on the other.”
st.carriere-silex.desc: “Here we break rocks. With other rocks.”
st.cercle-troc.desc: “Today's rate: one goat = three goats, depending on the mood.”
st.champ.desc: “Plant, wait, wait some more. The first idle game.”
st.feu-camp.desc: “The first open-plan office. Everyone around it, nobody working.”
ui.away.nothing: Nothing new: no station was running.
ui.away.title: While you were away
ui.era.ended: End of the era. The story continues with era 2.
ui.market.closed: The market opens with the Barter circle.
